title: the tree-stratum tooth judges scratch orient berths beside the live ones
intention: inference_domain's tree-stratum tooth judges scratch orient berths on every box, and still judges the live ones where they stand.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_no_orient_packet_since_the_fix_reports_the_tree_stratum_unavailable asserted 'no orient packet berthed after 2026-09-07 to read'; orient berths stand only on the box that charted, so the tooth reads red wherever nothing was charted.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and Law 5 (berths are instance-space); f153192145dd's shape.
how: Factor _reports_unavailable(paths) -> list of paths whose unknowns hold 'tree stratum unavailable'. The tooth writes two scratch berths named orient-20261017T132655-<x>.json: one with the phrase only in request and unknowns clean, one with the phrase in unknowns; asserts the predicate names exactly the second; then asserts it names none of the live late berths (zero live berths is allowed).

clauses.claim: tooth 4 of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain_answers_the_bus.py is green on akienasus, which holds no orient berth after 2026-09-07
tooth 4 reds when _reports_unavailable is hollowed to name nothing

decisions.text: D1: tooth 4 judges two scratch late orient berths with the factored predicate, then the live late berths.

measured.saw: AssertionError: no orient packet berthed after 2026-09-07 to read
measured.how: bin/cairn test over the proof on akienasus
